source: Minimized from real proxy-events.jsonl lines (2026-09-25, Codex 0.157.0 through Agent Code's responses proxy): three /v1/responses exchanges from one session, in recorded event order, with the recorded request/response/response-end kinds and the recorded chunk COUNT per response. REDACTED (steering q9): request bodies dropped; headers reduced to content-type and x-codex-window-id; in every SSE `data:` JSON, every string value is replaced by '[redacted N chars]' except structural keys, and the `tools` and `input` arrays echoed inside `response` objects are emptied (the adapter reads neither); remaining strings are redacted except structural keys (type, id, item_id, call_id, status, sequence_number, indices, role, object, model, name). The SSE was rebuilt from the redacted frames and re-split into the recorded number of chunks at even byte offsets, so frames still straddle chunk boundaries. What is real and load-bearing: the event types and their order, every exchange streaming to response.completed, and only req-3 getting a response-end (the client closed the others first; 16 of 32 exchanges in the full recording had none).
